global_visual_profile.visual_style: cinematic sacred-documentary realism with Vietnamese Buddhist restraint, symbolic transitions, and human domestic detail
global_visual_profile.color_palette: warm wood, muted gold, soft white, gentle gray, deep brown, restrained amber, calm shadow
global_visual_profile.lighting_philosophy: domestic late-afternoon light and lamp glow; sacred scenes use diffuse gold-white light without fantasy beams; boundary scenes are cooler but not bleak
global_visual_profile.camera_philosophy: one calm camera idea per six-second prompt: slow dolly, gentle tracking, static contemplation, or controlled crane movement
global_visual_profile.motion_intensity: low to moderate, meditative, no chaotic movement or rapid flicker
global_visual_profile.character_consistency_policy: Buddha and sacred figures remain dignified, medium-wide/profile/silhouette when detailed character guidance is incomplete; no random face, robe, or costume changes
global_visual_profile.buddhist_art_reference_policy: traditional and symbolic Buddhist representation only; do not claim exact heavenly architecture or photographic historical reconstruction
global_visual_profile.symbolic_visualization_policy: symbolic scenes must be clearly symbolic and must not pretend to be scripture, history, or proof
global_visual_profile.semantic_segmentation_policy: Narration context is segmented by complete sentence, clause, action, emotional beat, or narrative idea before six-second clip allocation; contexts may overlap across adjacent clips.
global_visual_profile.text_on_screen_policy: no text rendered inside generated footage, no subtitles, no readable private data
negative_constraints: no modern objects in ancient scenes
